references.text: The prophet Isaiah also uses the image of new and old in another context, illustrating the need for renewal.
Although it is not a direct parallel, this verse reflects the idea of something old that is no longer suitable for something new, as in Jesus' parable.
Jeremiah uses the image of an old wineskin in a similar way to Jesus, to illustrate that the old cannot contain the new.
The author of Hebrews speaks of how the old has become obsolete and is near to vanishing, which resonates with Jesus' point about the new and the old.
